generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The method `isPointGeometry` is introduced to check if the given geometries array contains only a single point geometry. This is a good refactoring step, but ensure that this method is used consistently across other parts of the codebase where similar checks are needed.

review_comment: I imagine an edge case where we have a multi-point, but all points are the same, or at least quantize to the same point.
indeed, this requires a bit more work but this is still an improvement.
I see this fix was already in the geo_point case from years ago. So this increases symmetry too.
